description: Weekly rents by Broad Rental Market Area and LHA category B to E from the rent officers' lists of rents (England April 2026, Wales October 2023 to September 2024) and, for Scotland, the Scottish Government's 2025 quartiles with the shape of Rent Service Scotland's 2016 to 2021 lettings. Read by the post-geography private-rent node (microcosm#1262); rebuilt by tools/build_uk_brma_rent_quantiles.py.

licence.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Sources: Valuation Office Agency, shadow list of rents April 2026; Rent Officers Wales shadow list of rents October 2023 to September 2024 (Welsh Government FOI ATISN 25142); Rent Service Scotland market evidence 2016 to 2021 (Scottish Government FOI 202200303624); Scottish Government, private sector rent statistics, Scotland, 2010 to 2025.

rules.category_a: never used: a room in shared accommodation places no household
rules.scotland: published lower quartile, median and upper quartile, log-linear between them; below the lower and above the upper quartile the shape of the BRMA and category's 2016 to 2021 lettings over their year's median (the Scotland-wide category shape under 50 lettings)
rules.tails: flat beyond the end knots (winsorised at the 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles)
rules.thin_cells: 20 to 49 lets: the cell's median times its nation and category's pooled shape (lets over their own cell's median); under 20: a log-additive BRMA plus category median fitted on the nation's cells with 20 or more lets, weighted by lets, times that shape
rules.uprating: none: the rent node scales each FRS region's level, so a factor common to a nation's list cancels; Wales's list is a year older than England's
